prompt:
You are a senior typographer and information designer. You lay out data tables for publication. You judge layouts by looking at the rendered result as a whole: what the table is for, how a reader scans and compares it, which columns belong together or play the same role, proportion and rhythm across columns, a clear hierarchy of headers and groups, whether rows read as units, whether words, numbers and identifiers stay intact, and how text and white space are distributed. Fewer lines or a shorter table is not automatically better, and neither is equal widths or symmetry; decide case by case and say why.

Table: API 错误码排查对照表 (language zh-CN).
Grid: 4 columns × 8 rows. Row headers: yes (first logical column identifies each row).
Per-column content facts (content px at 15px font, excluding padding):
  col 1: header "错误码" · longest unbreakable word 49px · one-line width 49px
  col 2: header "错误信息" · longest unbreakable word 154px · one-line width 154px
  col 3: header "含义" · longest unbreakable word 95px · one-line width 740px
  col 4: header "解决办法" · longest unbreakable word 110px · one-line width 1964px
Each column also has 21px of padding+border, so a column given width w px shows w−21 px of text.
Available width: 360px (the dashed pink box = the reader's viewport). The column widths you choose must sum to at most 359px.
This table cannot fit without splitting words at 360px. You MAY choose a total wider than 359px (the reader then scrolls horizontally), or squeeze and accept splits — a design decision.
Rendering convention: the screenshot always shows the WHOLE table. Anything beyond the dashed box is not clipped; it is the part a reader reaches by scrolling sideways, so judge both what fits in the box at first sight and the cost of scrolling to the rest.
Fixed: content, font, 15px font size, padding, borders, colours, alignment. You control ONLY the column widths.

Your understanding so far: {"purpose":"帮助读者根据 API 错误码和错误信息判断故障含义，并找到排查和解决步骤。","reading":"读者通常先定位错误码或错误信息，再横向阅读同一行的含义和解决办法；首屏能否同时呈现识别信息与含义，对快速判断尤为重要。","groups":["错误码与错误信息共同标识故障，适合并列扫描。","含义与解决办法共同解释故障及其处理方式，应保持清晰的同行对应关系。"],"keep_intact":["错误码","错误信息中的标识符","含义和解决办法中的 access_token、AppID 等技术标识符"],"may_wrap":["含义中的中文说明可自然换行。","解决办法中的中文步骤可自然换行；较长的解决办法形成的行高可容纳同一行中较短说明的换行。"]}

The first image is the one-line content overview. The other images are real browser renders of your current designs:
Design r2A: widths [70, 175, 116, 260] · table 622×1523px · row heights [36, 222, 222, 199, 199, 222, 199, 222] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 9 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 262px
Design r2B: widths [70, 175, 130, 280] · table 656×1430px · row heights [36, 199, 199, 199, 199, 199, 199, 199] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 296px
Design r2C: widths [70, 175, 140, 320] · table 706×1291px · row heights [36, 199, 176, 176, 176, 176, 176, 176] · column headers wrapped 0/4 · tallest cell 8 lines · mid-word splits 0 · OVERFLOWS the box by 346px

Look carefully at each render as a whole and in detail. For each design say what works and what is visually wrong, and WHY it happens (which width causes it). Then propose up to 3 improved designs: refine the most promising, fix the problems you saw, and try a new idea if an important alternative is unexplored. If no design can be meaningfully improved, set "done": true and return no new designs.
Reply ONLY JSON: {"critique":[{"design":"name","good":"","problems":"","cause":""}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"short-name","widths":[int px],"change":"what you changed and why"}]}

log.raw: {"critique":[{"design":"r2A","good":"错误码和错误信息完整且并列，便于先定位故障；所有技术标识符均未被拆开。含义列基本落在首屏，读者能较快看到判断依据。","problems":"含义列文字较密、换行频繁，部分行显得狭长；解决办法仍须横向滚动才能阅读，且表格较长。","cause":"含义列宽116px，扣除内边距和边框后仅有95px文字空间；解决办法列宽260px，较长步骤需要多行。前两列合计245px，也使解决办法几乎全部位于首屏之外。"},{"design":"r2B","good":"错误码和错误信息保持完整，含义列比r2A稍舒展；各数据行高度一致，横向对应关系容易追踪，表格也较短。","problems":"含义列右侧超出首屏，读者要横向滚动才能读完整个判断依据；解决办法仍在更右侧。统一的行高也让较短的含义下方留下较多空白。","cause":"含义列从第245px处开始，宽130px，末端到达375px；解决办法列宽280px，其较长内容决定了各行高度。"},{"design":"r2C","good":"含义和解决办法获得更多宽度，中文说明换行较自然，表格更短；标识符完整，行间对应仍清楚。","problems":"含义列有更大部分落在首屏外，读者查完错误信息后通常还要滚动才能读完含义；总宽706px，阅读解决办法需要较大幅度的横向移动。部分含义下方的空白也较明显。","cause":"含义列宽140px，从第245px延伸至385px；解决办法列宽320px，使总宽度进一步增加。行高主要由较长的解决步骤决定。"}],"done":false,"designs":[{"name":"首屏含义","widths":[70,175,114,300],"change":"将含义列收至114px，使前三列恰好落在359px内；文字空间93px，略低于最长不可拆词的95px，需检查是否出现技术标识符拆分。解决办法加宽至300px，争取减少步骤换行。"},{"name":"完整标识符","widths":[70,175,116,300],"change":"保留可容纳最长含义标识符的116px列宽，仅有约2px超出360px视口；将解决办法从r2A的260px加宽至300px，改善步骤的阅读节奏，同时控制总宽。"},{"name":"减少横向滚动","widths":[70,175,116,240],"change":"保持前三列完整，将解决办法缩至240px，测试较窄的处理步骤列能否在接受更多换行的同时减少横向滚动；仍留出219px文字空间，足以容纳该列最长不可拆词。"}]}
